title: Glove box access and size
summary: This topic centers on glove box usability, with complaints about hard-to-find or awkward release controls and comments that the compartment is smaller or limited.

positive.summary: One positive example mentions a sound being located near the glove box area rather than praising the glove box itself.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the glove box as difficult to locate or open because the release is awkward, tiny, or hard to see, and some also criticize reduced storage space or poor functionality.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a smaller glove box, trouble opening it, or a need for better lighting, but the excerpts do not always make the sentiment explicit.

limitations: The positive sample is not a true endorsement of the glove box and instead references the glove box area as the source location of a sound.
Several undetermined excerpts describe smaller size, visibility, or opening difficulty, but the provided labels prevent treating them as explicit negative sentiment.
The topic includes both glove box access issues and storage-size comments, which are related but not identical concerns.
